description: Metric dictionary implementing PRD section 20.2. PRD R-19 requires definitions, exclusions, owners and freshness to be explicit before metrics drive decisions.

globalRules.timeZone: Tenant default time zone from config/environments.json. System event timestamps are stored in UTC. PRD section 17.3.
globalRules.businessCalendar: REQUIRES_STAKEHOLDER_DECISION_OQ-18. Business-day arithmetic assumes Monday-Friday excluding a configured holiday list until confirmed.
globalRules.baselineStatus: All targets are proposed acceptance hypotheses until baselined. PRD OQ-17, section 7.
globalRules.privacy: Adoption and acknowledgement metrics are reported in aggregate. Individual-level data is restricted to the assignee, their manager and the process owner. PRD NFR-016.

metrics.name: Control completeness
metrics.formula: count(effective documents passing all required metadata and approval-evidence checks) / count(effective documents)

metrics.name: Findability success
metrics.formula: count(users completing the current-document task within 60 seconds) / count(users tested)
metrics.method: At least 10 representative pilot users, no facilitator assistance. PRD NFR-008.

metrics.name: Approval cycle time
metrics.formula: median(business days from valid submission to final decision); stage percentiles reported separately
metrics.exclusions: Cancelled and withdrawn submissions; approved test data.

metrics.name: Overdue review rate
metrics.formula: count(effective documents past DmsNextReviewDate) / count(effective documents due for review)
metrics.exclusions: Documents withdrawn or under an approved suspension.

metrics.name: Ownerless effective documents
metrics.formula: count(effective documents whose DmsDocumentOwner does not resolve to an active Entra identity)

metrics.name: Workflow success
metrics.formula: count(terminal successful lifecycle runs) / count(all eligible terminal runs)
metrics.exclusions: Approved test runs and user-cancelled requests. Duplicate side effects must equal zero.

metrics.name: Aged blocking exceptions
metrics.formula: count(open exceptions where DmsIsBlocking = true and age > AgedBlockingExceptionHours)
metrics.escalation: Any item breaching the threshold is escalated automatically.

metrics.name: Stale check-out rate
metrics.formula: count(documents checked out beyond StaleCheckOutThresholdBusinessDays) / count(checked-out documents)

metrics.name: Retention mapping coverage
metrics.formula: count(in-scope classes with an approved mapping) / count(all in-scope classes)
metrics.note: A class whose retentionAuthority is REQUIRES_RECORDS_APPROVAL counts as unmapped.

metrics.name: Retention-label conformance
metrics.formula: count(sampled records carrying the expected label and state) / count(sampled records)

metrics.name: Disposition backlog
metrics.formula: count(due disposition items open more than 30 days) / count(all due items)

metrics.name: Acknowledgement completion
metrics.formula: count(acknowledgements completed by due date) / count(assigned acknowledgements)

metrics.name: Pilot adoption
metrics.formula: count(eligible users with >= 1 qualifying DMS interaction in 30 days) / count(eligible pilot users)

metrics.name: Uncontrolled current-document incidents
metrics.formula: count(verified cases where a DMS experience presented the wrong revision as current)
metrics.note: This is the single most important trust metric. A DuplicateCurrentRevision or MissingCurrentRevision exception that reached a reader counts here.

metrics.name: Recovery conformance
metrics.formula: latest restore exercise completed within approved RTO with data within approved RPO
metrics.note: Interim planning assumption is 24-hour RPO and 8-business-hour RTO until OQ-06 is answered. PRD NFR-013.
